description: Where a waiting photo's slider starts: 0.01 past the photo picked before it (anchor), never past 1. An anchor is { t } (a photo the server placed), { waiting: key } (one that waited too) or null (the first of its batch). placed maps a waiting key to where the user put it, or null when it was removed; anchors maps a waiting key to its own anchor. Points are { lon, lat, t }, t in epoch seconds.

cases.name: the first of a batch starts at the beginning
just after a photo the server placed
just after where a waiting one was put
past a removed one, to what came before it
past a removed one to the start when nothing came before
